description: Relative elapsed time within the screening event window sampled at 10 Hz
notes: Starts at 0.0s for each event; step is 0.1s (100 to 300 samples per window)

description: Unique identifier for the screening event window
notes: Primary key identifying contiguous 10-30 second screening interactions

description: Operational screening session / deployment shift identifier
notes: Grouping key used for session-level splitting to prevent train/test data leakage

description: Physical edge screening unit hardware node identifier
notes: Specific NARCOSCAN deployment edge device generating telemetry

description: Railway station platform or checkpoint location identifier
notes: Categorical station checkpoint location tag

description: Simulated GPS latitude of railway station deployment node
notes: Simulated spatial coordinate with station-level micro-dither

description: Simulated GPS longitude of railway station deployment node
notes: Simulated spatial coordinate with station-level micro-dither

description: Metal-oxide semiconductor gas sensor 1 response (broad hydrocarbon / smoke surrogate)
notes: Baseline ~150-250 ppm_eq; responsive to broad volatile hydrocarbons and smoke

description: Metal-oxide semiconductor gas sensor 2 response (combustible gas / LPG surrogate)
notes: Baseline ~250-350 ppm_eq; moderate cross-sensitivity to environmental moisture

description: Metal-oxide semiconductor gas sensor 3 response (alcohol / volatile solvent surrogate)
notes: Baseline ~50-120 ppm_eq; sharp sensitivity to hand sanitizers, perfumes, and solvent diluents

description: Metal-oxide semiconductor gas sensor 4 response (nitrogenous organic / air quality surrogate)
notes: Baseline ~100-200 ppm_eq; responsive to amine/ammonia-like synthetic target profiles

description: Non-contact infrared optical thermopile reading of screened subject or baggage surface
notes: Captures luggage surface temperature, body thermal emission, or exothermic reaction heat

description: Internal ambient temperature inside the screening portal chamber
notes: Tracks portal environmental baseline temperature with diurnal drift

description: Differential temperature contrast (target_temperature_C minus ambient_temperature_C)
notes: Critical thermal signature; positive values indicate body heat or exothermic anomalies

description: Relative atmospheric humidity within the screening portal enclosure
notes: Modulates MOS surface conductivity; essential for environmental baseline compensation

description: Barometric atmospheric pressure inside the screening portal
notes: Monitors chamber ventilation drafts, passing train air displacement, and elevation baseline

description: Passive Infrared (PIR) motion detection state within screening aperture
notes: Binary state: 1 when active human movement is detected in the focal zone, 0 otherwise

description: Ultrasonic / ToF rangefinder distance to target object or passenger
notes: Physical proximity; active screening focal window is gated when proximity < 80 cm

description: Cumulative motion trigger pulses registered within current screening event window
notes: Monotonically non-decreasing counter per screening event window

description: Ground truth screening risk classification target label
notes: Supervised classification target (60% NORMAL, 25% UNKNOWN, 15% HIGH_RISK_SCREENING_EVENT)

description: Controlled generative simulation regime category

description: Injected synthetic anomaly magnitude scalar

description: Simulated environmental / microclimatic profile state
